Ruth Chris Happy Hour Menu: Discover Mouthwatering Appetizers and Drinks

If you’re searching for a fine dining experience with a relaxed atmosphere and affordable prices, the Ruth Chris Steak House Happy Hour menu is exactly what you need. This iconic American steakhouse, known for its USDA prime beef, impeccable service, and upscale environment, brings a special happy hour menu offering mouthwatering appetizers and drinks at fantastic prices.

From succulent steaks to hand-crafted cocktails, Ruth Chris Steak House delivers a unique combination of taste and ambiance. Whether you’re looking for light bites or full-size dinner menu items, Ruth’s Happy Hour selections are crafted to impress.

What Makes Ruth Chris Steak House Happy Hour Special?

Ruth Chris Steak House sets the stage for an exquisite happy hour experience. The happy hour times vary slightly by location, but typically, guests can enjoy discounted cocktails, wine, and appetizers Monday through Friday during late afternoon and early evening.

Fine Dining Meets Casual Pricing

You don’t need to spend a fortune to savor the bold flavors of Ruth Chris. The happy hour menu offers a selection of discounted dishes and beverages, allowing you to enjoy Ruth’s Chris Steak House quality at more wallet-friendly prices.

Happy Hour Times Monday – Friday 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Location Varies by City

The Ruth’s Chris Steak House Happy Hour Menu: An Overview

The happy hour menu at Ruth Chris offers an exciting selection of hand-crafted cocktails, refreshing wines, and mouthwatering appetizers. The full dinner menu is also available, but the happy hour specials are not to be missed. Guests can expect:

  • Steakhouse classics like prime beef and succulent large shrimp
  • Hand-crafted cocktails and wine selections
  • Savory appetizers paired with a glass of wine
  • Crispy, flavorful bar bites perfect for sharing

Appetizer Selections

No happy hour is complete without appetizers, and Ruth Chris has no shortage of options. Guests rave about dishes like the shrimp appetizer and prime beef sliders, all cooked to perfection. The happy hour menu features popular items from the regular menu, ensuring that you experience the same high-quality flavor.

Appetizer Description Happy Hour Price
Succulent Large Shrimp Served with a spicy cream sauce $12
Prime Beef Sliders USDA prime beef, topped with bleu cheese $10
Crispy Crab Cakes Lightly fried with a tangy cucumber salad $14

Hand-Crafted Cocktails and Swizzle Swirl Specials

For those who prefer handcrafted cocktails, Ruth Chris’s happy hour delivers premium drinks designed to hit the spot. Guests can enjoy swizzle swirl happy hour cocktails that are made with the finest ingredients and expert craftsmanship. Whether you like a classic martini or a refreshing mojito, the happy hour cocktail menu offers something for every palate.

Hand-Crafted Cocktail Ingredients Price
Classic Martini Gin, vermouth, olive garnish $8
Swizzle Swirl Mojito Rum, mint, lime, swirl happy hour exclusive $9
Cucumber Cooler Vodka, cucumber, tangy cucumber salad garnish $7

Perfect Steaks Paired with Wine and Beer

It’s not just the cocktails that shine at Ruth Chris—new world wines and premium beers are also part of the happy hour specials. You can pair your prime beef with a glass of wine from their carefully curated wine list or enjoy a cold beer with your bar bites.

Steak and Wine Pairing: A Match Made in Heaven

The Ruth Chris Steak House experience isn’t complete without indulging in their famous steaks. USDA prime beef, cooked to perfection, paired with a full-bodied red wine or a crisp white, will elevate your happy hour experience to another level.

Wine and Beer Selections Type Happy Hour Price
Cabernet Sauvignon Full-bodied red wine $8 per glass
Chardonnay Crisp white wine $7 per glass
Local Craft Beer Selection varies by location $5 per glass

Exploring the Full Dinner Menu During Happy Hour

Although the happy hour menu provides excellent value, guests are always welcome to explore the full dinner menu. Whether you’re craving a perfect steak or seafood, you won’t be disappointed. The Ruth Chris Steak House reputation for offering high-quality meats and ingredients is well known.

Special Happy Hour Events at Ruth Chris Steak House

Occasionally, Ruth Chris Steak House hosts special events during happy hour, such as the September Tastemaker Event. These events showcase unique menu items, such as crab appetizers, succulent large shrimp, and limited-time wine and beer selections, offering an extra layer of excitement for regular guests.

Why You Should Reserve Your Seat for Happy Hour

Due to its popularity, it’s always a good idea to reserve your seat for happy hour at Ruth Chris. Whether you’re a fan of swizzle swirl happy hour cocktails or just want to enjoy the sizzle of a perfect steak, booking in advance ensures you won’t miss out on these fantastic happy hour specials.

Why Ruth Chris Steak House is the Best Spot for Happy Hour

With its mouthwatering food, fine dining ambiance, and premium selection of wine and cocktails, Ruth Chris Steak House delivers an experience unlike any other. Here are a few reasons why Ruth Chris is the ideal spot for happy hour:

  • Hand-crafted cocktails and fine wines at unbeatable prices
  • Appetizers that are filling and flavorful
  • Steakhouse classics that showcase Ruth Chris’s commitment to quality

FAQ Section

Q1: What are Ruth Chris Happy Hour Times?
A: Happy hour times vary by location but are typically from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

Q2: What is included in Ruth Chris Happy Hour Menu?
A: The happy hour menu includes a variety of appetizers, hand-crafted cocktails, wine, and beer, all at discounted prices.

Q3: Is Ruth Chris Happy Hour available on weekends?
A: The happy hour special is generally available only during the week, but it’s best to check with your local Ruth Chris Steak House for specific details.

Q4: Can I order from the dinner menu during happy hour?
A: Yes, guests are welcome to order from the full dinner menu during happy hour in addition to the happy hour specials.

Q5: Do I need to make a reservation for happy hour?
A: While walk-ins are welcome, it’s a good idea to reserve your seat to ensure availability during busy hours.

Q6: What’s the price range for happy hour items?
A: Happy hour menu prices generally range from $5 to $15, offering great value on drinks and appetizers.

Conclusion

The Ruth Chris Steak House Happy Hour is a culinary delight, offering premium steakhouse classics, hand-crafted drinks, and savory appetizers at affordable prices. Whether you’re enjoying the happy hour specials with colleagues after work or indulging in a quiet dinner, Ruth Chris Steak House delivers an unforgettable happy hour experience every time.
